mapper.sql: id, project_id, application_id, environment_id, code, name, status, risk_level, source_summary_json::text as source_summary_json, tags_json::text as tags_json, created_by, updated_by, archived_at, created_at, updated_at

id, scene_id, project_id, step_order, step_type, action_summary_json::text as action_summary_json, locator_strategy_json::text as locator_strategy_json, assertion_summary_json::text as assertion_summary_json, wait_policy_json::text as wait_policy_json, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at

where.if: and ( position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(code, ''))) > 0 or position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(name, ''))) > 0 )

mapper.update: update ui_e2e_scene set application_id = #{applicationId}, environment_id = #{environmentId}, name = #{name}, status = #{status}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, source_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{sourceSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), tags_json = cast(coalesce(#{tagsJson}, '[]') as jsonb), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status != 'ARCHIVED'
update ui_e2e_scene set status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status != 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.select: select from ui_e2e_scene_step where scene_id = #{sceneId} order by step_order asc
mapper.insert: insert into ui_e2e_scene_step ( id, scene_id, project_id, step_order, step_type, action_summary_json, locator_strategy_json, assertion_summary_json, wait_policy_json, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{sceneId}, #{projectId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, cast(coalesce(#{actionSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{locatorStrategyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{assertionSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{waitPolicyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
